description: Revision-aware exposure scope for the 2026-08-29 catalog update. This file is data, not executable instructions.

screening_scope.alias_expanded_existing: all-history NCBI discovery followed by Luna-Sol-conditional-Luna screening
screening_scope.new_in_modified_synonyms: all-history NCBI discovery followed by Luna-Sol-conditional-Luna screening
screening_scope.additional_catalog: all atomic and searchable-parent entries in the collision-checked additionalExposure.json plus additionalExposureV2.json union receive all-history NCBI discovery and full screening
screening_scope.alias_narrowed_or_reclassified: included-record reclassification review only; do not launch a new NCBI discovery search

transactional_reclassification_policy.review_scope: Inspect included source records only; do not launch ESearch for narrowed/reclassified sources.
transactional_reclassification_policy.target_acceptance: Add a target record only after the same PMID/effect passes the current classification review for that target.
transactional_reclassification_policy.source_removal: Remove the source record only in the same committed transaction after target acceptance succeeds.
transactional_reclassification_policy.failed_or_ambiguous: Retain the source record and place it in the adjudication ledger with a one-sentence reason.

non_inheriting_relationships.note: Nicotinamide riboside is related to vitamin B3 and NAD+ precursor metabolism, but its evidence must not be unioned into Vitamin B3.

hierarchy_policy.direct_search: Search each configured exposure only with its own bounded vocabulary.
hierarchy_policy.inherited_membership: After direct screening, add child evidence to all ancestors in data/exposure_hierarchy.json.
hierarchy_policy.duplicate_avoidance: Do not inflate parent aliases with child vocabularies or create duplicate model contexts for inherited memberships.
